_what: The overnight fleet. One agent per feature area, each with owned files, the gates that guard it, and the named defects it is accountable for.
_why_verification_not_autofix: Every agent here VERIFIES and REPORTS. None of them edits code unattended. That is deliberate: every serious outage on this project came from an unattended change that passed static checks — a blank homepage, a white /auth, every crawled row discarded. An agent that reports a defect with evidence costs nothing if it is wrong. An agent that edits at 4am and is wrong costs a morning. Fixes are approved in the morning and applied inside a cell.
